                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_3 \\mod{n_3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 1 \\mod{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 7 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ପ୍ରଥମ ଦୁଇଟି ସମାନତା ସମାଧାନ କରିବା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 1 \\mod{2} \\Rightarrow x = 2k + 1\\) କିଛି ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣସଂଖ୍ୟା k ପାଇଁ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସମାନତାରେ ବଦଳ କରନ୍ତୁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(2k + 1 \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(2k \\equiv 1 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(k \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\) (ଯେହେତୁ 2 ମଡ୍ 3 ର ଗୁଣନ ବ୍ୟତିକ୍ରମ 2 ଅଟେ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(k = 3m + 2\\) କିଛି ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣସଂଖ୍ୟା m ପାଇଁ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ପୁନର୍ବାର ବଦଳ କରନ୍ତୁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 2(3m + 2) + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 6m + 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ, ତୃତୀୟ ସମାନତା ବିଚାର କରନ୍ତୁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(6m + 5 \\equiv 7 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(6m \\equiv 2 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(3m \\equiv 1 \\mod{4}\\) (ଯେହେତୁ 6 ≡ 3 mod 8)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(m \\equiv 3 \\mod{4}\\) (ଯେହେତୁ 3 ମଡ୍ 4 ର ଗୁଣନ ବ୍ୟତିକ୍ରମ 3 ଅଟେ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(m = 4n + 3\\) କିଛି ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣସଂଖ୍ୟା n ପାଇଁ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ପୁନର୍ବାର ବଦଳ କରନ୍ତୁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 6(4n + 3) + 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 24n + 18 + 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 24n + 23\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଏହିପରି, କ୍ରମଟି \\(x = 24n + 23\\) ରୂପର ଅଟେ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଆମକୁ ଏହି କ୍ରମରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପଦଟି ଦରକାର:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(n = 1\\) ପାଇଁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 24(1) + 23\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 47\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              କ୍ରମରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପଦଟି ହେଉଛି 47 |

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਦੋਂ ਕ੍ਰਮਵਾਰ 2, 3, ਅਤੇ 8 ਨਾਲ ਵੰਡਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ 1, 2, ਅਤੇ 7 ਬਾਕੀ ਛੱਡਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸਮਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਚੀਨੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਮੇਯ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_1 \\mod{n_1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_2 \\mod{n_2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_3 \\mod{n_3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸਾਨੂੰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਛੋਟਾ ਧਨਾਤਮਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਕ x ਲੱਭਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 1 \\mod{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 7 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਆਓ ਪਹਿਲੀਆਂ ਦੋ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਲ ਕਰੀਏ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 1 \\mod{2} \\Rightarrow x = 2k + 1\\) ਕਿਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਕ k ਲਈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(2k + 1 \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸੰਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਦੋਂ ਕ੍ਰਮਵਾਰ 2, 3, ਅਤੇ 8 ਨਾਲ ਵੰਡਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ 1, 2, ਅਤੇ 7 ਬਾਕੀ ਛੱਡਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸਮਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਲ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਚੀਨੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਮੇਯ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_1 \\mod{n_1}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_2 \\mod{n_2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv a_3 \\mod{n_3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸਾਨੂੰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਛੋਟਾ ਧਨਾਤਮਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਕ x ਲੱਭਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 1 \\mod{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 7 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਆਓ ਪਹਿਲੀਆਂ ਦੋ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੱਲ ਕਰੀਏ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x \\equiv 1 \\mod{2} \\Rightarrow x = 2k + 1\\) ਕਿਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਕ k ਲਈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(2k + 1 \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(2k \\equiv 1 \\mod{3}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(k \\equiv 2 \\mod{3}\\) (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ 2 ਮਾਡ 3 ਦਾ ਗੁਣਾਤਮਕ ਉਲਟ 2 ਹੈ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(k = 3m + 2\\) ਕਿਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਕ m ਲਈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਵਾਪਸ ਬਦਲੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 2(3m + 2) + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 6m + 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਹੁਣ, ਤੀਜੀ ਕਾਂਗਰੂਐਂਸ 'ਤੇ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(6m + 5 \\equiv 7 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(6m \\equiv 2 \\mod{8}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(3m \\equiv 1 \\mod{4}\\) (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ 6 ≡ 3 ਮਾਡ 8)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(m \\equiv 3 \\mod{4}\\) (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ 3 ਮਾਡ 4 ਦਾ ਗੁਣਾਤਮਕ ਉਲਟ 3 ਹੈ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(m = 4n + 3\\) ਕਿਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਕ n ਲਈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਵਾਪਸ ਬਦਲੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 6(4n + 3) + 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 24n + 18 + 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 24n + 23\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ, ਕ੍ਰਮ \\(x = 24n + 23\\) ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸਾਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੂਸਰਾ ਪਦ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(n = 1\\) ਲਈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 24(1) + 23\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\(x = 47\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੂਸਰਾ ਪਦ 47 ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is Quit India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Quit India Movement, also known as the August Kranti, was launched by Mahatma Gandhi on 8 August 1942 during World War II, demanding an end to British rule in India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The movement was a mass protest involving millions of Indians, including significant participation from students, workers, and peasants.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Gandhi gave the call for "Do or Die" in his Quit India speech delivered at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Mumbai.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Despite the British government's severe repression, the movement marked a crucial turning point in the Indian independence struggle, galvanizing the Indian population against colonial rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Khilafat Movement\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Khilafat Movement (1919-1924) was a pan-Islamist political campaign launched by Muslims in British India to influence the British government and protect the Ottoman Caliphate after World War I.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It was initiated by leaders like Maulana Shaukat Ali, Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar, and Abul Kalam Azad.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The movement also aimed to bring Hindus and Muslims together in the struggle against British colonial rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • However, it lost momentum after the abolition of the Caliphate in Turkey in 1924.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Home Rule Movement\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Home Rule Movement was led by Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant between 1916 and 1918.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It aimed at achieving self-governance within the British Empire for India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The movement used a moderate approach, focusing on petitions and public meetings to build national consciousness.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It laid the groundwork for more radical movements and played a key role in uniting Indian leaders and the public.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Swadeshi Movement\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Swadeshi Movement was part of the Indian independence movement and was a response to the British Partition of Bengal in 1905.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It encouraged Indians to boycott British goods and promote Indian-made products.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The movement saw the rise of nationalistic pride and economic self-sufficiency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It also led to the establishment of various indigenous industries, schools, and national institutions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
